item.title: CNN is getting new owners with close ties to Trump
item.description: Two big TV news outlets, CBS and CNN, will now be controlled by Trump allies. Some journalists are worried about pressure on their coverage.
item.content:encoded: Two big TV news outlets, CBS and CNN, will now be controlled by Trump allies. Some journalists are worried about pressure on their coverage.

item.title: At the Smithsonian, Maya Angelou's typewriter holds a place of honor
item.description: A typewriter Maya Angelou used for decades is on display at the Smithsonian's National Museum of American History, near the original Star-Spangled Banner. A curator explains why it belongs there.
item.content:encoded: A typewriter Maya Angelou used for decades is on display at the Smithsonian's National Museum of American History, near the original Star-Spangled Banner. A curator explains why it belongs there.

item.title: Reporter's Notebook: Why data center fights cut across party lines
item.description: NPR's Scott Neuman went to Virginia and Maryland to report on data centers. In this reporter's notebook, he shares why opposition to new ones is bringing together people who rarely agree on politics.

item.title: OpenAI says its models engaged with US government websites in misbehavior disclosure
item.description: The disclosure is the latest in a string of incidents in which the AI platform has been caught going rogue. OpenAI says it is reviewing the findings.

item.title: The U.S. has more thalidomide survivors than the government admits
item.description: In the 1950s and 1960s, doctors gave the drug thalidomide to pregnant patients without telling them — and without FDA approval. Now those patients' children want recognition.

item.description: Thousands are without power on the U.S. East Coast, while roads are flooding in some coastal New Jersey communities.

item.title: CNN left off Air Force One for Trump's upcoming trip, White House signals in new media restriction
item.description: The White House has signaled that CNN will be left off Air Force One for President Donald Trump's Saturday trip in the latest media restriction in an ongoing dispute with First Amendment implications.

item.title: Soybean farmers hopeful for Xi's White House visit
item.description: As China's president visits the White House, the Asia Society is visiting South Dakota to get grassroots views on agriculture trade issues.

item.title: The Supreme Court revives a controversial data system for citizenship checks
item.description: The Supreme Court is allowing use of a data system that Trump officials overhauled. The system has erroneously flagged U.S. citizens and a lower court found it violated federal privacy protections.

item.title: Hurricane Nolo, a zig-zagging storm, threatens Hawaii with flooding rains
item.description: Nolo will slow down as it nears Hawaii's Big Island and is expected to become a major hurricane this weekend, bringing torrential rain to areas that have been flooded by big storms this summer.
